secrets.name: CODE_STATS_TOKEN
secrets.how: Fine-grained token code-stats-<date>, resource owner workbench-soft, All repositories, 1 year, Repository permissions Contents read-only. Metadata read-only comes with it.
secrets.revoke: Delete the older code-stats token on https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens.
secrets.cost: pages.yml reads it to count the private repos for the Engineering section, and lumiere-desktop-mac.yml checks out lumiere-player with it. Without it the site hides the code numbers and the Lumiere Mac build fails.

secrets.name: GAMES_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64
secrets.how: Keep it. The Play upload key of Workbench Games: a new one needs an upload key reset in Play Console. Bitwarden holds it under the same name.
secrets.cost: games-play.yml reads it to sign the Play bundle. Without it the nightly upload fails.

secrets.name: GAMES_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
secrets.cost: games-play.yml reads it to sign the Play bundle. Without it the nightly upload fails.

secrets.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
secrets.how: Add key, Create new key, JSON. The browser saves a .json file.
secrets.cost: Delete the old key in Google Cloud once every repo of the group has the new one.
